decision: U10 plan APPROVED with three corrections. Module layout broker/<transport>/spring-boot-starter approved on ADR 0133 decision 6 (transport is the primary grouping axis) and ADR 0072 (framework/ groups the store axis, mixing axes there is what 0072 separated). Property schema approved, defaults verbatim from the builders, retry shape from the existing WaitBackoffProperties precedent, group.id and queue stay per-call per ADR 90. Open question 1 decided: the starter does NOT own RabbitMQ Connection construction, spring-boot-starter-amqp owns connection config and duplicating it is the overengineering branch, and the choice is reversible additively (a uri convenience property can come later), the starter javadoc states the app supplies the Connection bean and why. Open question 2 decided: the pre-seeded bridge-factory shape is approved as the minimal seam that satisfies the issue's bridge scope, since ADR 90 makes bridges inherently per-consumer so zero-arg bean seams cannot express them, and the returned Builder keeps every knob overridable. Corrections: (1) @ConditionalOnProperty on bootstrap-servers must be proven against BOTH YAML binding forms, the indexed list form is a known gap for that conditional, test both or gate differently; (2) factory-built bridges are not beans, so their close lifecycle is the application's, state it in the factory javadoc the same way the example bootstraps teach it; (3) the new leaf poms follow the AGENTS.md new-publishable-module rules, no name or metadata redeclaration (the U3/U5 lesson).
why: Unattended terms: the orchestrator decides what AGENTS.md, the ADRs, and prior rulings answer, with the derivation shown. Every choice in this plan traces to a recorded principle; neither open question is a taste question once the overengineering rule and the reversibility asymmetry are applied.
